name: prof-f14-dove — extracted from f14-dove
palette: Cool, desaturated daylight for introspection and self-critique, with occasional warmer beige and cream notes in domestic inserts to signal comfort and reflection.
light_logic: Soft, high-key natural light from large windows in the loft to keep everything honest and observational, with slightly dimmer, cozier light for intimate hand and ritual shots.
lens: Shallow-focus close-ups and macro details for vulnerability and fixation, moving to wider, slightly longer-lens views that keep subjects grounded in a spacious, airy environment.
texture: Matte, natural skin and fabric textures; visible pores, denim grain, steam and ceramic glaze to emphasize realism over gloss.
world: A real-feeling industrial loft repurposed as a neutral studio-lab, plus glimpses of a calm domestic setting; minimal props, lots of negative space, everything arranged to feel documentary but gently composed.
forbidden: Overly glossy beauty lighting or heavy retouching that erases real skin texture
Fast, flashy cutting or hyper-saturated color that breaks the reflective tone
Overt product glamour shots that overshadow the human experiment
Heavy-handed voice-of-god narration that tells the viewer what to think
Crowded locations or busy backgrounds that distract from the emotional comparison
